checkpoint_persistence.rule: AGENTS.md P8.2.1 and the maintainer's section 6: every expensive unit persisted when it completes
checkpoint_persistence.training: save points every 1,851 steps (keep_last 1) and the final checkpoint on the network volume as written: weights, AdamW state, step, CPU and CUDA RNG states, consumed-sequence position, config hash and the bound data and initialization identities (checkpoint.bind_identity); a later attempt resumes from the last valid save point
checkpoint_persistence.initializations_and_corpora: persisted with their sha256 at completion (volume and relay) and reused, never regenerated
checkpoint_persistence.evaluation: each unit's generations, rows and report persisted when complete; a scored unit is never re-evaluated
checkpoint_persistence.retention: every new checkpoint kept through the analysis and the maintainer's review; then retired under AGENTS.md 2.5 when no consumer remains
